title: CONNECT-IP Target and Protocol Scope Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP target, ipproto, scoped route advertisement, and access-control policy.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpTargetScope` and `Http3ConnectIpProtocolScope` parse Figure 6 target and ipproto values, while `Http3ConnectIpScopePolicy` adds route-advertisement filtering, IP-version classification, single-version prefix policy, and access-control rejection decisions. URI Template expansion continues to percent-encode IPv6 colons and prefix slashes before request dispatch.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper surfaces are stateless policy checks. They do not own DNS resolution, address assignment state, or route capsule serialization.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Prefix lengths are constrained to the address bit length.
Prefix lower bits must be zero outside the covered prefix.
ICMPv4 and ICMPv6 remain allowed even when a specific ipproto is scoped.
risks: Live DNS resolution and route capsule emission remain adapter work.
ADDRESS_ASSIGN and ROUTE_ADVERTISEMENT capsule wire formats remain separate slices.
